answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the jetty of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. The ocean holds work receipts rather than names, so the fable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on multi-party computation for private attestation.
